title: Not every valuable exploration starts with a mature KPI
text: Pearson’s curiosity essay presents interestingness as an early search signal when the eventual application is not yet known. As a counterweight to rigid portfolio scoring, it supports reserving some bounded exploration space rather than requiring every learning activity to promise immediate financial return.
qualification: Conceptual essay, not evidence that curiosity alone predicts commercial value. Exploration still needs resource boundaries and a learning record.
